about: Nine teasers before launch, 26 Sep to 4 Oct 2026 (days -8 to 0 before START_DATE 2026-10-05), 8:30 pm. Each shows a problem, a blurred real dish and one letter of the 10-letter hunt phrase (given out of order). The first 5 correct DMs from 4 Oct, 8:30 pm win. The prize venue is not confirmed yet: confirm it before announcing winners.

posts.caption:
Tum ne bhi dekha hai. Menu pe perfect tasveer. Table pe... kuch aur.

We got tired of it. So we did something about it. 5 October ko pata chalega.

THE HUNT

Every teaser from tonight to 4 October hides one letter of a secret phrase (10 letters, Roman Urdu). The badge tells you where it goes: "letter 4 of 10" means it is the 4th letter.

Collect all 10. DMs count from 4 October, 8:30 pm, when the last letters drop. DM @eatmenva the phrase. The first 5 correct DMs win:

- a premium dine-in, on us
- a private after party
- MENVA Black, free, as founding members

Rules: Lahore only, 18+, one entry per account. Winners are announced on our Story and contacted by DM; we will never ask for money or card details. Venue and date shared with the winners. This hunt is run by MENVA and is not sponsored, endorsed or run by Instagram.

Want the secret early? DM us "secret".
